title: Experts race to secure tens of thousands of UK fridges after a critical flaw, LBC reports
date_note: Published November 20; the flaw was discovered in October per LBC.
summary: LBC reports that cyber experts are racing to secure tens of thousands of fridges and freezers across Britain's retail and foodservice sectors after researchers found a significant flaw in October. LBC says Omega Systems first uncovered it and Pen Test Partners verified it. The article names no product, vendor, CVE or fix. It also reports disruption to refrigeration at stores in Europe, with no group claiming responsibility.
plain: LBC reports a race to secure tens of thousands of UK fridges and freezers after researchers found a significant flaw; no product or fix is named.
exec: Refrigeration used by UK retailers and food suppliers is reported to carry a significant flaw; LBC reports disruption at European stores.
action: Retail and foodservice operators: check with your refrigeration vendor whether your units are affected and follow their and NCSC guidance; no fix is named in the report.

validation.note: Only LBC read; no vendor, CVE or official advisory in the article; Omega Systems and Pen Test Partners findings are as relayed by LBC.
